en: A black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a busy harbor with numerous ships, cranes, and industrial docks along both sides of a wide river or estuary. In the foreground are dense rooftops of older multi‑story buildings; in the distance the waterway stretches toward low hills. The image has printed captions at the bottom identifying the scene and the museum ownership, plus an archive number.
